title: Loyalty Credit for Long-Standing Northgate+ Business Members
content:
**Loyalty credit.** Under the Business closure schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, a business that has renewed its membership year after year receives a loyalty credit added to the Business refund, counted by the settled annual fee charges on the membership record, the current one included. One month's share of the fee is the fee divided by the paid term in months.

| Settled annual fees on the membership | Added to the Business refund |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | one month's share multiplied by 0.125 |
| exactly 2 | one month's share multiplied by 0.0625 |
| fewer than 2 | nothing |

The credit is added before the Business refund is capped at the fee, rounded down to the cent and floored at zero.

**Hypothetical illustration (one month's share 16.00).** A membership carrying 4 settled annual fees adds 2.00; one carrying exactly 2 adds 1.00; one carrying a single fee adds nothing.
